name: Does PDFree send my PDF to a server to encrypt it?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Encryption is performed entirely in your browser using the PDF-Lib library. Your file never leaves your device.

name: What encryption standard does PDFree use?

acceptedAnswer.text: PDFree uses AES-256 encryption, the same standard used by banks and government systems.

name: Can I set separate passwords for opening and editing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can set an owner password (for editing/printing restrictions) separately from a user password (for opening the file).
AES-256 is practically uncrackable by brute force. Use a strong, unique password for best security.
